Remove legacy untracked checkpoint payloads from stopped sessions

Usage: mj purge-untracked [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>    Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --session <SESSION>  Session whose legacy untracked checkpoint payloads should be removed
      --all                Purge every session the daemon holds
      --no-splash          Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
      --dry-run            Report on-disk bytes that would be reclaimed without rewriting archives
      --json               Print the response as JSON
  -h, --help               Print help
